entries.title: Update failed to install
entries.what: An update could not be installed. The error code is decoded below.
causes: Damaged update cache or component store
fix: Free disk space (at least 10-20 GB on C:)
Reset Windows Update components (stop wuauserv/bits, rename SoftwareDistribution)
Install the update manually from the Microsoft Update Catalog

entries.title: Restart required to finish updates
entries.what: Updates were installed and need a restart to complete.

entries.title: Update download started
entries.what: Windows Update started downloading an update.

entries.title: Package installed
entries.what: A Windows package (update or feature) was installed successfully.

entries.title: Restart needed for package
entries.what: A restart is needed before a Windows package can finish installing.

entries.title: Windows activation failed
entries.what: License activation failed. The error code is decoded below.
fix: Check activation in Settings > System > Activation

entries.title: Software Protection restart scheduled
entries.what: The Software Protection service scheduled its next restart. Routine and harmless.

entries.title: Software Protection restart could not be scheduled
entries.what: Software Protection could not schedule its restart task. Very common and normally harmless.

entries.title: Software Protection service status
entries.what: Routine Software Protection (licensing) status record. Harmless.
